entries.title: Shops looted as German cost of living protests turn violent
entries.summary: The protests in cities across Germany - including Berlin, Hamburg and Frankfurt - came on the same day hundreds of thousands also protested in France.

entries.title: Healey risks breaking minimum wage promise for younger workers
entries.summary: The Chancellor has suggested that younger workers might not receive the same minimum wage as others before the next election.

entries.title: Democrats are used to heartbreak in Texas - could Talarico turn the tide?
entries.summary: The state's $500m Senate race may be the most closely watched in the US midterms, and is about far more than control of Congress.
